gloss: windbreak; wind shield; protection against the wind

definitions.gloss: windbreak; wind shield; something used to block or shelter from the wind
definitions.explanation: A fence, wall, row of trees, tarp, or other barrier placed to block wind. Also used of clothing or gear designed to protect the body from wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{風|かぜ}よけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We set up a windbreak around the tent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{松林|まつばやし}→松林：27916_matsubayashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役目|やくめ}→役目：00423_yakume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: The pine grove along the coast serves as a windbreak.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧、{風|かぜ}よけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: This jacket is light and just right as protection against the wind.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ ('wind') and the nominalized verb stem of ⟦{避|よ}ける→避ける：14848_yokeru⟧ ('to avoid; to ward off'). The pattern noun + ⟦よけ→よけ：28839_yoke⟧ 'something to keep X away' is productive: {虫|むし}よけ ('insect repellent'), {日|ひ}よけ ('sunshade; awning'), {雨|あめ}よけ ('rain shelter').

USAGE:
Used for both permanent structures (walls, tree rows designed as windbreaks) and temporary items (tarps, camping gear). Can also describe clothing: {風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧ ('a windbreaker jacket'). Often appears in ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-phrases modifying other nouns, e.g. {風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧ ('windbreak wall').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塀|へい}→塀：03613_hei⟧: windbreak wall
- {風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{林|はやし}→林：01702_hayashi⟧: windbreak forest / row of trees
- {風|かぜ}よけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a windbreak
- {風|かぜ}よけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a windbreak
- {風|かぜ}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役目|やくめ}→役目：00423_yakume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to function as a windbreak

- {防風|ぼうふう}: wind protection — formal; {防風|ぼうふう}{壁|へき} = 'windproof wall'
